name: Gibbering Mouther
summary: An aberration of mouths and eyes whose babbling unsettles the mind.

traits.name: Aberrant Ground
traits.text: The ground in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the mouther is Difficult Terrain.

traits.name: Gibbering
traits.text:
The mouther babbles incoherently while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* {dc:str}, any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther while it is babbling. *Failure:* The target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does during the current turn:

**1–4.** The target does nothing.

**5–6.** The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction.

**7–8.** The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. The target dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack. Its body is then absorbed into the mouther, leaving only equipment behind.

actions.name: Blinding Spittle

save.targets: each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 30 feet

actions.onFailure: and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mouther's next turn.
